title: The Sun
info: The Sun is the star at the center of our solar system.
It gives Earth light and heat. Life on Earth needs that light.
The Sun is huge, but it looks small because it is very far away.
Never look straight at the Sun. It can hurt your eyes.

questions.q: Why does the Sun look small in the sky?
options: It is behind the Moon all day

questions.q: Is it safe to stare at the Sun?
options: No, it can hurt your eyes

questions.q: Type the name of the star closest to Earth.
questions.explain: The Sun is our closest star.
